description: Backlog loop: after a one-item /planwise backlog session prints its BACKLOG LOOP marker, compact the session and re-enter the handler with --loop-resume. Feedback drafting: registers the draft_feedback tool and saves model-drafted feedback locally. Plan building: registers the build_plan tool, which writes a build spec and bodies files to {planwise_root}/plan-build/<plan name>/ and runs scripts/plan_build.py on them. Agent guard: checks planwise:task-runner dispatches (spawn-prompt clauses, background Agent calls, runner stops that look unfinished, bare cd and file-read Bash verbs inside a runner, and git verbs that rewrite the shared working tree or index); it reports by default and refuses only when the plugin option agent_guard is deny. Session update check: at session start, compares the running plugin, the installed copy and the project pin, and shows an update banner when one is behind; the plugin option update_check turns it off.
